## Is this a constitutional change?

Per [`GOVERNANCE.md` §12](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#12-kips), a change to
what a conforming Kyne implementation is required to do — language
syntax, runtime semantics, compiler architecture, the memory model,
standard library behavior, toolchain behavior, or governance — is a
**KIP**, not this issue template. Please use the
[KIP proposal template](./kip_proposal.md) instead if this is the case.

This template is for feature requests that do **not** require amending a
constitutional document (for example, a new `kyne doctor` check, or an
improvement to an existing, already-specified diagnostic's wording).

What you'd like to see, and why.
